preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of roads m must be positive and at most the maximum possible for n cities (n*(n-1)/2).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities numbered between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(set((int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])) == int(stdin.split()[1])
preconditions.description: No duplicate roads exist in the input.
The graph must have at least two cities (1 and n).

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible average number of safe roads among all shortest paths from city 1 to city n, where a safe road is one incident to the city with the police station.
The output is a non-negative real number not exceeding the total number of roads.
